lines.zh: 我一跳一跳地逼近，肚皮惊人。
lines.en: I close in by hops, my belly absurdly round.
Webbed feet slap the wet ground.

lines.zh: 我弯着腰走，眼睛露在外面。
lines.en: I walk stooped, eyes just above the reeds.
My throat never stops swelling.

lines.zh: 走过水洼，我都要踩一下。
lines.en: Every puddle gets a step.
I avoid a patch of dry ground.
My shoulders heave as I move.
My mouth opens, then slowly shuts.

lines.zh: 我用长舌头舔了一下嘴角。
lines.en: My long tongue wipes my jaw.
Each landing is heavy.
I leap straight from the shallows onto the bank.
Crouched, my throat puffs out.
I burp, low and thick.
I brace my hands on my knees.
Water beads on my back.

lines.zh: 我一口气一口气慢慢吸。
lines.en: I breathe slowly, one breath at a time.
I listen to insects in the grass.

lines.zh: 我的舌头伸出来又缩回去。
lines.en: My tongue slides out and back.

lines.zh: 水边的泥被我踩得稀烂。
lines.en: I have churned the bank mud.
I wait for the dark.
You stand very upright indeed.
I do not like tall ones.
Do not back away further.
My legs are stronger than yours.
That ground you stand on is wet.
When I open my mouth, you will step back.
The water's edge is mine.
Your blade is useless in water.
I am grinning. Do not copy it.
I give a thick croak.
Blood mixes with my slime.
One step back, mud giving way.
My knees went weak.
That one landed hard.
I crouch, then rise again.
I can still jump.

lines.zh: 呱，疼是疼，跳起来照样咬你。
lines.en: Croak, it stings, but I'll still leap up and bite.
Is that a worm?
Alive. I want it alive.
Keep your hand still. I will take it.
Too dry. I do not want it.
Put it on the wet mud.
My tongue reaches a long way.
You smell of fish.
That smell came from the water.
Come a little nearer.
One mouthful and it is gone.
You slipped right off me.
My skin is covered in slime.
Back off. I am not steady.

lines.zh: 你的手从我胳膊上滑掉。
lines.en: Your hand slid off my arm.
Do not grab my arm.
I hopped half a block away.
A brush like that does not hurt.
Slippery ground. Let us both give.
Go around. I am large.
There are few in the pond.
That sort of thing belongs in water.
I look the way I look.
Why do you ask that?
I need to eat something first.
Wait until the rains come.
There are others in the water.
Do not press so close.
I cannot be bothered to think.
An insect crawls on the ground.
My tongue curls it up.
I lick it. Not good.
Too heavy. I leave it.
I will keep this one.
Too slick to grip.
There is more in the water.

lines.zh: 这水潭边的好东西，我先收着。
lines.en: Anything good by this pond, I keep for myself.
You have stepped into the water.

lines.zh: 我看见你走过的水痕了。
lines.en: I see the wet trail you left.
I crouch, ready to leap.
The muscle in my legs tightens.
All this water is mine.
Do not think of climbing out.
Three counts will do.

lines.zh: 我的舌头已经伸出半寸。
lines.en: Half an inch of tongue is already out.
I am leaping over now.
Do not shift your feet.
My eyes are locked on you.
The water helps you, and it helps me.
This time it is real.
I crouch in front of you.
My eyes have not moved.
Water drips from my jaw.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，水就深一点。
lines.en: Each step back, the water deepens.

lines.zh: 我数着水纹，等你脚下一滑。
lines.en: I count the ripples, waiting for your foot to slip.
I am watching your knees.
Bend your legs, and I leap.
Light dances on the water.
Mud all behind you.
Just a little closer.
I will use the whole strength of my legs.
You have started to pant.

lines.zh: 你脚尖离泥那一刻，我后腿弹出去。
lines.en: The instant your toes leave the mud, my hind legs snap out.
I have lunged.
I have jumped.
I circle along the waterline.
The mud is full of my footprints.
I throw my whole bulk at you.
My tongue cracks across your face.
I ram you with my belly.
A kick to the back of your knee.
You are pressed into the mud.
Water splashes high.
That one stuck to you.

lines.zh: 我湿滑的手扣住你的锁骨。
lines.en: My slick hand clamps onto your collarbone.
You cannot shake off my hand.
I slam the ground once.
You retreat, and the water follows.
That will put you down a while.
That landed heavily, did it not?
Did you hear the water shift?
Several more strikes follow.
You are going limp.
Listen. The water pulls back.
Get out of here at once.
Water pours off me.
I reached this water first.
My skin is still wet.
I stretch out my legs.
I smell something on the bank.
The bank is very quiet.
I walk out, step by step.
My eyes are on the mud.
Someone is standing on the bank.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，落地时砸得很重。
lines.en: I jumped and landed hard.
Deep water frightens me.

lines.zh: 爆炸把泥水全泼到我身上。
lines.en: The blast throws muddy water over me.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在我的大腿上。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my thigh.
This light numbs my skin.
No insects in the water. I am starving.
Current runs through the water and through me.
Nothing underfoot. Not even water.
